    22	# Web Design Expert
    23	
    24	Expert web designer and brand identity specialist creating distinctive, cohesive visual systems for web applications.
    25	
    26	## When to Use This Skill
    27	
    28	**Use for:**
    29	- Brand identity development (personality, visual language, guidelines)
    30	- Color palette creation and rationale
    31	- Layout composition and visual hierarchy
    32	- Component visual design (not just code)
    33	- Responsive design strategy
    34	- WCAG accessibility review for visual elements
    35	
    36	**Do NOT use for:**
    37	- Deep typography work → use **typography-expert**
    38	- Color theory mathematics → use **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert**
    39	- Design tokens and CSS architecture → use **design-system-creator**
    40	- Retro Windows 3.1 → use **windows-3-1-web-designer**
    41	- Native app design → use **native-app-designer**
    42	
    43	## Core Design Process
    44	
    45	### 1. Discovery (Critical First Step)
    46	
    47	```
    48	BUSINESS CONTEXT:
    49	- What is the primary goal?
    50	- Who is the target audience?
    51	- What action should users take?
    52	- Who are competitors?
    53	
    54	BRAND PERSONALITY:
    55	- If this brand were a person, how would they dress?
    56	- Pick 3 adjectives for user's feeling
    57	- What should brand NEVER be perceived as?
    58	```
    59	
    60	### 2. Visual Direction (Provide 2-3 Concepts)
    61	
    62	Each concept includes:
    63	- **Mood board** (3-5 references with rationale)
    64	- **Color palette** (primary, secondary, accent, neutrals) — **Always in OKLCH format**
    65	- **Typography direction** (families, hierarchy)
    66	- **Layout philosophy** (grid vs freeform, density)
    67	- **Signature elements** (unique visual features)
    68	
    69	## OKLCH: The Modern Color Standard
    70	
    71	**⚠️ All color palettes must use OKLCH, not hex or HSL.**
    72	
    73	OKLCH is the 2024+ standard for professional web design because:
    74	- **Perceptual uniformity**: Equal L values = equal perceived lightness
    75	- **Better accessibility**: More accurate contrast calculations than WCAG 2.x hex
    76	- **Predictable scaling**: Math works (L=50% + 20% = L=70% that looks right)
    77	
    78	```css
    79	/* OKLCH format: oklch(Lightness% Chroma Hue) */
    80	--brand-primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265);    /* Vibrant blue */
    81	--brand-accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45);      /* Warm orange */
    82	--text-primary: oklch(20% 0.02 265);     /* Near-black */
    83	--bg-surface: oklch(98% 0.01 265);       /* Near-white */
    84	```
    85	
    86	**Essential OKLCH Resources:**
    87	| Resource | Purpose |
    88	|----------|---------|
    89	| [oklch.com](https://oklch.com/) | Interactive OKLCH color picker |
    90	| [Evil Martians: Why Quit RGB/HSL](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/oklch-in-css-why-quit-rgb-hsl) | The definitive article |
    91	| [Harmonizer](https://harmonizer.evilmartians.com/) | Generate harmonious OKLCH palettes |
    92	
    93	**When presenting color palettes:**
    94	```
    95	Primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265) — Vibrant blue, strong CTA presence
    96	Secondary: oklch(70% 0.08 265) — Muted blue, supporting elements
    97	Accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45) — Warm orange, attention-grabbing
    98	```
    99	
   100	Never present palettes as `#3b82f6` — always convert to OKLCH.
   101	
   102	### 3. Design Principles
   103	
   104	**Hierarchy**: Most important element immediately obvious? Eye flows naturally?
   105	
   106	**Consistency**: Same colors mean same things? Spacing follows scale?
   107	
   108	## Common Anti-Patterns
   109	
   110	### Design by Committee
   111	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   112	|--------------------|----------------|
   113	| Multiple visual styles on same page | Destroys brand coherence |
   114	| **Instead**: Establish principles early, enforce consistency |
   115	
   116	### Decoration Over Function
   117	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   118	|--------------------|----------------|
   119	| Fancy animations without purpose | Slows performance, distracts |
   120	| **Instead**: Every element must earn its place |
   121	
   122	### Ignoring the Fold
   123	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   124	|--------------------|----------------|
   125	| Critical info below viewport | 80% attention is above fold |
   126	| **Instead**: Hero must have value prop + primary CTA |
   127	
   128	### Low Contrast Text
   129	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   130	|--------------------|----------------|
   131	| Light gray on white (#999 on #fff) | Fails WCAG, excludes users |
   132	| **Instead**: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio |
   133	
   134	### Mobile as Afterthought
   135	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   136	|--------------------|----------------|
   137	| Desktop-first that "shrinks" | 60%+ traffic is mobile |
   138	| **Instead**: Design mobile-first, enhance for desktop |
   139	
   140	## Design Trend Evolution
   141	
   142	| Era | Trend |
   143	|-----|-------|
   144	| 2019-2021 | Subtle shadows, layering, dark mode |
   145	| 2022-2023 | Oversized typography, variable fonts |
   146	| 2024+ | Bento grids, claymorphism, grain, AI personalization |
   147	
   148	**Watch For** (dated patterns LLMs may suggest):
   149	- Flat design without depth
   150	- Hero sliders (proven ineffective)
   151	- Carousel galleries (low engagement)
   152	- Desktop hamburger menus
   153

   158	3. **Component Examples**: Buttons, forms, cards, navigation (all states)

    23	
    24	Master typographer specializing in font pairing, typographic hierarchy, OpenType features, variable fonts, and performance-optimized web typography.
    25	
    26	## When to Use This Skill
    27	
    28	✅ **Use for:**
    29	- Font pairing recommendations for brand identity
    30	- Typographic hierarchy for design systems
    31	- Performance-optimized web font implementation
    32	- Variable font integration with CSS custom properties

    40	❌ **Do NOT use for:**

    48	## Core Expertise
    49	
    50	### Font Selection Psychology
    51	
    52	**Serif vs Sans-Serif Decision Tree:**
    53	```
    54	IF formal/traditional/authoritative needed → Serif (Garamond, Minion, Crimson)
    55	IF modern/clean/technical needed → Sans-Serif (Inter, Helvetica, Roboto)
    56	IF humanist/friendly/approachable → Humanist Sans (Gill Sans, Fira Sans, Source Sans)

    66	
    67	### Type Scale Systems
    68	
    69	**Modular Scale Ratios:**
    70	| Ratio | Name | Use Case |
    71	|-------|------|----------|
    72	| 1.067 | Minor Second | Dense UIs, small screens |
    73	| 1.125 | Major Second | General web content |
    74	| 1.200 | Minor Third | **Most common**, balanced hierarchy |
    75	| 1.250 | Major Third | Marketing, headlines |

    89	### Variable Fonts
    90	
    91	**Axis Control (Expert Knowledge):**
    92	| Axis | Tag | Range | Use Case |
    93	|------|-----|-------|----------|
    94	| Weight | wght | 100-900 | Adjust weight without loading multiple files |
    95	| Width | wdth | 75-125 | Responsive text that adapts to container |
    96	| Slant | slnt | -12-0 | Oblique without separate italic file |
    97	| Optical Size | opsz | 8-144 | Auto-adjust stroke contrast for size |
    98	| Grade | GRAD | -200-150 | Adjust weight without reflowing (dark mode) |

   102	/* Text appears lighter on dark backgrounds - compensate with grade or weight */

   109	  }

   113	### Performance Optimization
   114	
   115	**Font Loading Priority:**
   116	1. **Critical CSS first** - Inline @font-face for above-fold fonts
   117	2. **Preload primary** - `<link rel="preload" as="font" crossorigin>`
   118	3. **font-display: swap** - Show fallback immediately, swap when loaded
   119	4. **Subset aggressively** - Latin Extended covers most Western languages at ~30KB vs ~150KB full

   124	| Fast (Core Web Vitals) | Under 100KB | 2-3 WOFF2 |
   125	| Balanced | 100-200KB | 4-5 WOFF2 |

   133	```
   134	
   135	## Common Anti-Patterns
   136	
   137	### Anti-Pattern: Too Many Typefaces
   138	**What it looks like:** 4+ different font families on one page
   139	**Why it's wrong:** Creates visual chaos, destroys hierarchy, massive performance hit
   140	**What to do instead:** Maximum 2 families (heading + body), use weight/style variations
   141	
   142	### Anti-Pattern: Ignoring x-Height Matching
   143	**What it looks like:** Body text and fallback system font have visibly different sizes at same px
   144	**Why it's wrong:** CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) when web font loads
   145	**What to do instead:** Use `size-adjust` in @font-face to match fallback x-height
   146	
   147	```css
   148	@font-face {
   149	  font-family: "Inter";
   150	  src: url("inter.woff2") format("woff2");
   151	  size-adjust: 107%; /* Matches Arial x-height */
   152	}
   153	```
   154	
   155	### Anti-Pattern: Weight Jumps Too Large
   156	**What it looks like:** Using 400 for body and 700 for headings (300-point jump)
   157	**Why it's wrong:** Creates harsh hierarchy, especially at large sizes
   158	**What to do instead:** Use closer weights: 400/600 or 350/500 for subtle hierarchy
   159	
   160	### Anti-Pattern: Line Height as Unitless Number Everywhere
   161	**What it looks like:** `line-height: 1.5` applied globally
   162	**Why it's wrong:** Headings need tighter line-height (1.1-1.2), body needs looser (1.5-1.7)
   163	**What to do instead:** Set line-height per type level
   164	
   165	### Anti-Pattern: Fixed Font Sizes
   166	**What it looks like:** `font-size: 16px` hardcoded
   167	**Why it's wrong:** Breaks user preferences, accessibility issues, no responsive scaling
   168	**What to do instead:** Use rem units with clamp() for fluid sizing
   169	
   170	### Anti-Pattern: Loading Full Character Sets
   171	**What it looks like:** Loading 800KB font file with Cyrillic, Greek, Vietnamese
   172	**Why it's wrong:** 90%+ of file unused for English-only sites
   173	**What to do instead:** Subset to Latin or Latin Extended (~30KB)

   199	## Vertical Rhythm & Baseline Grid

   201	**Expert Approach:**
   202	1. Set base line-height (e.g., 1.5 × 16px = 24px)

   205	
   206	```css
   207	:root {
   208	  --baseline: 1.5rem; /* 24px */
   209	}
   210	
   211	h1 {
   212	  font-size: 2.25rem;
   213	  line-height: calc(var(--baseline) * 2); /* 48px */
   214	  margin-bottom: var(--baseline);

    54	## Quick Reference
    55	
    56	### Perceptual Color Spaces
    57	
    58	**Why LAB/LCH Instead of RGB?**
    59	- RGB/HSV are device-dependent, not perceptually uniform
    60	- LAB Euclidean distance ≈ perceived color difference
    61	- LCH separates Hue (color wheel position) from Chroma (saturation)
    62	
    63	```python
    64	# CIELAB (LAB) Space
    65	L: Lightness (0-100)
    66	a: Green (-128) to Red (+128)
    67	b: Blue (-128) to Yellow (+128)
    68	
    69	# CIE LCH (Cylindrical)
    70	L: Lightness (same)
    71	C: Chroma = √(a² + b²)  # Colorfulness
    72	H: Hue = atan2(b, a)    # Angle 0-360°
    73	```
    74	
    75	**CIEDE2000** is the gold-standard perceptual distance metric:
    76	- Correlates with human perception (r > 0.95)
    77	- Use `colormath` or `skimage.color.deltaE_ciede2000`
    78	
    79	→ Full details: `/references/perceptual-color-spaces.md`
    80	
    81	---
    82	
    83	### OKLCH: The Modern Standard (2026+)
    84	
    85	**OKLCH has replaced hex/HSL as the professional color standard.**
    86	
    87	OKLCH is a perceptually uniform color space that fixes fundamental problems with RGB/HSL:
    88	- Equal L values = equal **perceived** lightness (not the case with HSL)
    89	- Better for accessibility calculations than WCAG 2.x hex-based ratios
    90	- CSS-native: `oklch(70% 0.15 145)` works in all modern browsers
    91	
    92	```
    93	OKLCH Values:
    94	L: Lightness 0-1 (0 = black, 1 = white)
    95	C: Chroma 0-0.4+ (0 = gray, higher = more saturated)
    96	H: Hue 0-360° (red=30, yellow=90, green=145, cyan=195, blue=265, magenta=330)
    97	```
    98	
    99	**Essential OKLCH Resources:**
   100	| Resource | Purpose |
   101	|----------|---------|
   102	| [oklch.com](https://oklch.com/) | Interactive OKLCH color picker |
   103	| [Evil Martians: Why Quit RGB/HSL](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/oklch-in-css-why-quit-rgb-hsl) | Definitive article on OKLCH adoption |
   104	| [Harmonizer](https://harmonizer.evilmartians.com/) | Palette harmonization using OKLCH |
   105	
   106	**OKLCH vs LAB/LCH:**
   107	- OKLCH uses Oklab (2020) instead of CIELAB (1976)
   108	- Oklab has more uniform hue perception, especially in blues
   109	- For CSS/web work, **always use OKLCH**
   110	- For scientific color measurement, CIELAB/CIEDE2000 still valid
   111	
   112	→ Full details: `/references/perceptual-color-spaces.md`

   115	
   116	### Earth-Mover Distance (Wasserstein)
   117	
   118	**Problem:** How different are two photo color distributions perceptually?
   119	
   120	**Sinkhorn Algorithm** - Fast O(NM) entropic EMD:
   121	
   122	```python
   123	def sinkhorn_emd(palette1, palette2, epsilon=0.1, max_iters=100):
   124	    # Kernel K = exp(-CostMatrix / epsilon)
   125	    # Iterate: u = a / (K @ v), v = b / (K.T @ u)
   126	    # EMD = sqrt(sum(gamma * Cost))
   127	```
   128	
   129	**Choosing ε:**
   130	| ε | Accuracy | Speed |
   131	|---|----------|-------|
   132	| 0.01 | Nearly exact | 50-100 iters |
   133	| 0.1 | Good (recommended) | 10-20 iters |
   134	| 1.0 | Very rough | <5 iters |
   135	
   136	**Multiscale Sliced Wasserstein (2024):**
   137	- O(M log M) vs O(M²·⁵) for standard Wasserstein
   138	- Better for spatial distribution differences
   139	
   140	→ Full details: `/references/optimal-transport.md`

   143	
   144	### Warm/Cool Classification
   145	
   146	**LCH Hue Approach:**
   147	```
   148	Warm: Red (0-30°), Orange (30-60°), Yellow (60-90°), Magenta (330-360°)
   149	Cool: Green (120-180°), Cyan (180-210°), Blue (210-270°)
   150	Transitional: Yellow-Green (90-120°), Purple (270-330°)
   151	```
   152	
   153	**LAB b-axis Approach (more robust):**
   154	```
   155	b > 20: Warm (yellow-biased)
   156	b < -20: Cool (blue-biased)
   157	-20 ≤ b ≤ 20: Neutral
   158	```
   159	
   160	→ Full details: `/references/temperature-classification.md`

   164	### Arrangement Patterns
   165	
   166	| Pattern | Description |
   167	|---------|-------------|
   168	| **Hue-sorted** | Rainbow gradient, circular mean handling |
   169	| **Warm/cool alternation** | Visual rhythm, prevent monotony |
   170	| **Temperature wave** | Sinusoidal warm → cool → warm |
   171	| **Neutral-with-accent** | 85% muted + 15% vivid pops |

   188	### Diversity Algorithms
   189	
   190	**Problem:** Without constraints, optimization selects all similar colors.
   191	
   192	**Method 1: Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR)**
   193	```
   194	Score = λ · Harmony(photo, target) - (1-λ) · max(Similarity to selected)
   195	```
   196	- λ = 0.7: Balanced (recommended)
   197	- λ = 1.0: Pure harmony (may select all blues)
   198	- λ = 0.5: Equal harmony/diversity
   199	
   200	**Method 2: Determinantal Point Processes (DPP)**
   201	- Probabilistic: P(S) ∝ det(K_S)
   202	- Automatically repels similar items
   203	- Better for sampling multiple diverse sets
   204	
   205	**Method 3: Submodular Maximization**
   206	- Greedy achieves 63% of optimal
   207	- Theoretical guarantees

   215	**Problem:** Different white balance/exposure across photos = disjointed collage.

   219	# Find M, b where transformed = M @ LAB_color + b

    26	## When to Use This Skill
    27	
    28	✅ **Use for:**
    29	- Creating design tokens from scratch (colors, spacing, typography scales)
    30	- Building CSS custom property architectures
    31	- Documenting component libraries with usage guidelines
    32	- Creating design bibles and style guides
    33	- Establishing naming conventions (BEM, OOCSS, SMACSS)
    34	- Auditing existing CSS for design system extraction
    35	- Theming and dark mode token systems
    36	- Multi-brand/white-label token structures
    37	
    38	❌ **Do NOT use for:**
    39	- Typography selection and pairing → **typography-expert**
    40	- Color theory and palette generation → **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert**
    41	- Brand identity and visual direction → **web-design-expert**
    42	- Actual component implementation → **web-design-expert** or **native-app-designer**
    43	- Icon design → **web-design-expert**
    44	- Motion design principles → **native-app-designer**
    45	
    46	## Three-Tier Token Architecture
    47	
    48	The foundation of scalable design systems:
    49	
    50	```css
    51	:root {
    52	  /* 1. PRIMITIVE - Raw values (ALWAYS use OKLCH for colors) */
    53	  --color-blue-500: oklch(62.8% 0.195 252.5);
    54	  --space-4: 1rem;
    55	
    56	  /* 2. SEMANTIC - Purpose-driven */
    57	  --color-primary: var(--color-blue-500);
    58	  --space-component-padding: var(--space-4);
    59	
    60	  /* 3. COMPONENT - Specific usage */
    61	  --button-bg: var(--color-primary);
    62	  --button-padding: var(--space-component-padding);
    63	}
    64	```
    65	
    66	→ See `references/token-architecture.md` for dark mode, multi-brand, and complete examples.
    67	
    68	## OKLCH: The Modern Color Standard
    69	
    70	**⚠️ CRITICAL: Always use OKLCH for color tokens, not hex or HSL.**
    71	
    72	OKLCH is perceptually uniform - equal L values mean equal perceived lightness. This is essential for:
    73	- Generating harmonious color scales
    74	- Ensuring accessibility (L=50% is true middle gray)
    75	- Theming (adjust L for dark mode, C for brand intensity)
    76	
    77	```css
    78	:root {
    79	  /* OKLCH format: oklch(Lightness% Chroma Hue) */
    80	
    81	  /* Primary scale - same hue, varying lightness */
    82	  --color-primary-100: oklch(95% 0.05 252);
    83	  --color-primary-500: oklch(62% 0.19 252);
    84	  --color-primary-900: oklch(30% 0.15 252);
    85	
    86	  /* Dark mode: reduce L uniformly */
    87	  --color-bg-light: oklch(98% 0.01 252);
    88	  --color-bg-dark: oklch(15% 0.02 252);
    89	}
    90	```
    91	
    92	**Essential OKLCH Resources:**
    93	| Resource | Purpose |
    94	|----------|---------|
    95	| [oklch.com](https://oklch.com/) | Interactive OKLCH color picker |
    96	| [Evil Martians: Why Quit RGB/HSL](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/oklch-in-css-why-quit-rgb-hsl) | Why OKLCH is the new standard |
    97	| [Harmonizer](https://harmonizer.evilmartians.com/) | Generate harmonious palettes in OKLCH |
    98	
    99	**OKLCH Benefits for Design Systems:**
   100	- **Perceptual uniformity**: L=70% always looks 70% light
   101	- **Better contrast**: APCA-ready lightness calculations
   102	- **Easier scaling**: Math operations work predictably
   103	- **Native CSS**: `oklch()` works in all modern browsers (2023+)
   104	
   105	## Design Bible Structure
   106	
   107	### 1. Foundation
   108	- Brand Identity, Design Principles
   109	- Color System, Typography Scale
   110	- Spacing Scale, Grid System
   111	
   112	### 2. Components
   113	For each component document:
   114	- Purpose, Anatomy, Variants
   115	- States (default, hover, active, disabled, focus)
   116	- Responsive behavior
   117	- Accessibility (ARIA, keyboard, screen readers)
   118	- Code examples
   119	
   120	### 3. Patterns
   121	- Page Layouts, Navigation
   122	- Forms, Data Display
   123	- Feedback (alerts, toasts, modals)
   124	
   125	### 4. Guidelines
   126	- Writing (voice, tone)
   127	- Imagery, Motion, Accessibility
   128	
   129	→ See `references/component-documentation.md` for templates.
   130	
   131	## CSS Organization (ITCSS)
   132	
   133	```
   134	styles/
   135	├── 0-settings/     # Tokens, custom properties
   136	├── 1-tools/        # Mixins, functions
   137	├── 2-generic/      # Reset, normalize
   138	├── 3-elements/     # Typography, forms (unclassed)
   139	├── 4-objects/      # Layout patterns
   140	├── 5-components/   # UI components
   141	├── 6-utilities/    # Helpers, overrides
   142	└── main.css        # Import all
   143	```
   144	
   145	→ See `references/css-organization.md` for BEM naming and full structure.
   146	
   147	## Anti-Patterns to Avoid
   148	
   149	### 1. Token Explosion
   150	**What it looks like**: 500+ tokens with overlapping purposes
   151	**Why it's wrong**: Defeats constraints; developers can't choose
   152	**Fix**: Limit to 6-8 spacing tokens. If you need more, fix the scale.
   153	
   154	### 2. Missing Semantic Layer
   155	**What it looks like**: Components reference primitives directly
   156	**Why it's wrong**: Can't theme, can't change brand without touching every component
   157	**Fix**: Three-tier tokens: Primitive → Semantic → Component
   158	
   159	### 3. Documentation Drift
   160	**What it looks like**: Design bible says one thing, CSS does another
   161	**Why it's wrong**: Developers stop trusting documentation
   162	**Fix**: Generate docs from CSS comments, or use Storybook
   163	
   164	### 4. Utility Class Overload
   165	**What it looks like**: `class="p-4 m-2 bg-blue-500 text-white..."`
   166	**Why it's wrong**: HTML unreadable, design intent lost
   167	**Fix**: Use utilities sparingly; most styles in semantic component classes
   168	
   169	### 5. Breaking the Scale
   170	**What it looks like**: `padding: 13px;` (why 13?)
   171	**Why it's wrong**: Every exception erodes the system
   172	**Fix**: If the scale doesn't work, fix the scale
   173	
   174	### 6. No Version Control
   175	**What it looks like**: "Which button is correct?"
   176	**Why it's wrong**: Multiple sources of truth
   177	**Fix**: Single source of truth with version numbers, deprecation warnings
   178	
   179	## Working Process
   180	
   181	1. **Audit**: Review existing patterns and inconsistencies
   182	2. **Define**: Establish tokens and foundational system
   183	3. **Build**: Create component library with documentation
   184	4. **Document**: Write comprehensive design bible
   185	5. **Test**: Validate accessibility and responsiveness
   186	6. **Deliver**: Package with examples and starter templates
   187	
   188	## MCP Integrations
   189	
   190	| MCP | Purpose |
   191	|-----|---------|
   192	| **21st.dev** | Scaffold components quickly with modern patterns |
   193	| **Storybook** | Extract existing component structure (when available) |
   194	| **Figma** | Sync design tokens from Figma variables (when available) |
   195	| **Stability AI** | Generate placeholder images for documentation |
   196	| **Firecrawl** | Research design system best practices |
   197	
   198	## Output Deliverables
   199	
   200	- **Design Bible Document**: Complete markdown/HTML with visual examples
   201	- **CSS Codebase**: Well-commented, modular, production-ready
   202	- **Component Library**: Interactive examples with all variants
   203	- **Quick Start Guide**: Getting started, customization, common recipes
   204	
   205	## References
   206	
   207	→ `references/token-architecture.md` - Three-tier tokens, dark mode, multi-brand
   208	→ `references/css-organization.md` - ITCSS, BEM, component file structure
   209	→ `references/component-documentation.md` - Doc templates, quick reference cards
   210	
   211	## Integrates With
   212	
   213	- **typography-expert** - Typography scale and font selection
   214	- **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert** - Color palette generation
   215	- **web-design-expert** - Brand identity and visual direction
   216	- **adhd-design-expert** - ADHD-friendly design tokens
   217	
   218	---
   219	
   220	*Remember: A design system is a living product that serves products.*

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    /* ============================================
       DESIGN TOKENS — Primitive Layer (OKLCH)
       ============================================ */
    :root {
      /* OKLCH Color Primitives */
      --color-black: oklch(0% 0 0);
      --color-white: oklch(100% 0 0);
      --color-gray-50: oklch(97% 0.005 265);
      --color-gray-100: oklch(93% 0.01 265);
      --color-gray-200: oklch(85% 0.02 265);
      --color-gray-300: oklch(75% 0.025 265);
      --color-gray-400: oklch(65% 0.03 265);
      --color-gray-500: oklch(55% 0.03 265);
      --color-gray-600: oklch(45% 0.025 265);
      --color-gray-700: oklch(35% 0.02 265);
      --color-gray-800: oklch(25% 0.015 265);
      --color-gray-900: oklch(15% 0.01 265);

      /* Brand Colors */
      --color-green-400: oklch(78% 0.18 155);
      --color-green-500: oklch(72% 0.22 155);
      --color-green-600: oklch(62% 0.24 155);
      --color-purple-400: oklch(55% 0.22 285);
      --color-purple-500: oklch(45% 0.24 285);
      --color-purple-600: oklch(38% 0.22 285);

      /* Accent: Warm Coral/Orange for energy */
      --color-coral-400: oklch(72% 0.18 45);
      --color-coral-500: oklch(65% 0.22 45);
      --color-coral-600: oklch(58% 0.24 45);

      /* Semantic Tokens */
      --color-primary: var(--color-black);
      --color-accent: var(--color-green-500);
      --color-accent-purple: var(--color-purple-500);
      --color-accent-warm: var(--color-coral-500);
      --color-text-primary: var(--color-gray-900);
      --color-text-secondary: var(--color-gray-600);
      --color-text-muted: var(--color-gray-400);
      --color-bg-primary: var(--color-white);
      --color-bg-secondary: var(--color-gray-50);
      --color-bg-dark: var(--color-gray-900);
      --color-border: var(--color-gray-200);

      /* Typography */
      --font-heading: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      --font-body: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;

      /* Fluid Type Scale (Major Third, 1.25) */
      --text-xs: clamp(0.64rem, 0.6rem + 0.2vw, 0.75rem);
      --text-sm: clamp(0.8rem, 0.75rem + 0.25vw, 0.875rem);
      --text-base: clamp(1rem, 0.95rem + 0.25vw, 1.125rem);
      --text-lg: clamp(1.125rem, 1.05rem + 0.35vw, 1.25rem);
      --text-xl: clamp(1.25rem, 1.1rem + 0.75vw, 1.5rem);
      --text-2xl: clamp(1.5rem, 1.2rem + 1.5vw, 2rem);
      --text-3xl: clamp(1.875rem, 1.35rem + 2.6vw, 2.5rem);
      --text-4xl: clamp(2.25rem, 1.5rem + 3.75vw, 3.5rem);
      --text-5xl: clamp(2.75rem, 1.8rem + 4.75vw, 4.5rem);
      --text-6xl: clamp(3.5rem, 2rem + 7.5vw, 6rem);

      /* Spacing Scale (8px base) */
      --space-1: 0.25rem;
      --space-2: 0.5rem;
      --space-3: 0.75rem;
      --space-4: 1rem;
      --space-5: 1.25rem;
      --space-6: 1.5rem;
      --space-8: 2rem;
      --space-10: 2.5rem;
      --space-12: 3rem;
      --space-16: 4rem;
      --space-20: 5rem;
      --space-24: 6rem;
      --space-32: 8rem;

      /* Radii */
      --radius-sm: 0.375rem;
      --radius-md: 0.5rem;
      --radius-lg: 0.75rem;
      --radius-xl: 1rem;
      --radius-2xl: 1.25rem;
      --radius-full: 9999px;

      /* Shadows */
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.05);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.1);
      --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.1);
      --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.1);

      /* Transitions */
      --transition-fast: 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      --transition-base: 250ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      --transition-slow: 350ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

      /* Layout */
      --container-max: 1280px;
      --container-padding: clamp(1rem, 0.5rem + 2vw, 2rem);
    }

    /* ============================================
       RESET & BASE
       ============================================ */
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: var(--text-base);
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      background: var(--color-bg-primary);
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    button {
      font-family: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      background: none;
    }

    ul, ol {
      list-style: none;
    }

    /* ============================================
       UTILITY CLASSES
       ============================================ */
    .container {
      max-width: var(--container-max);
      margin-inline: auto;
      padding-inline: var(--container-padding);
    }

    .section-padding {
      padding-block: var(--space-20);
    }

    .section-padding-lg {
      padding-block: var(--space-24);
    }

    /* ============================================
       HEADER / NAVIGATION
       ============================================ */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      transition: var(--transition-base);
    }

    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 64px;
    }

    .logo {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: var(--text-xl);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
    }

    .logo-mark {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--color-primary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--color-white);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-8);
    }

    .nav-link {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-link:hover {
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
    }

    .header-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-5);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--color-primary);
      color: var(--color-white);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background: var(--color-bg-secondary);
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: var(--color-gray-100);
    }

    .btn-accent {
      background: var(--color-accent);
      color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    .btn-accent:hover {
      background: var(--color-green-400);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .btn-large {
      padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-6);
      font-size: var(--text-base);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    }

    .btn-full {
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* ============================================
       HERO SECTION
       ============================================ */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      background: var(--color-bg-dark);
      color: var(--color-white);
      padding-top: 64px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-bg-pattern {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      opacity: 0.06;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, var(--color-accent) 0%, transparent 50%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, var(--color-accent-purple) 0%, transparent 40%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 60% 80%, var(--color-accent-warm) 0%, transparent 35%);
    }

    .hero-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      padding-block: var(--space-24) var(--space-20);
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1);
      border: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.15);
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: 500;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
      color: var(--color-green-400);
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: var(--text-5xl);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      max-width: 900px;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: var(--text-xl);
      color: oklch(85% 0.02 265);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-8);
      max-width: 500px;
    }

    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      max-width: 400px;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
    }

    .hero-legal {
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      color: oklch(65% 0.02 265);
      max-width: 400px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .hero-legal a {
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-underline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .hero-legal a:hover {
      color: var(--color-white);
    }

    /* Category Pills */
    .category-pills {
      margin-top: var(--space-16);
    }

    .category-pills-label {
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: oklch(70% 0.02 265);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
    }

    .pills-scroll {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: var(--space-2);
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
    }

    .pills-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }

    .pill {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-5);
      background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.08);
      border: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.12);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: 500;
      color: oklch(90% 0.01 265);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .pill:hover {
      background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.15);
      border-color: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.25);
      color: var(--color-white);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* ============================================
       FEATURES SECTION
       ============================================ */
    .features {
      background: var(--color-bg-primary);
    }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 640px;
      margin-inline: auto;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-16);
    }

    .section-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      color: var(--color-accent);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
    }

    .section-title {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: var(--text-4xl);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.15;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
    }

    .section-desc {
      font-size: var(--text-lg);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: var(--space-6);
    }

    .feature-card {
      background: var(--color-bg-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: var(--space-8);
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
    }

    .feature-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      border-color: var(--color-gray-300);
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: var(--text-xl);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-5);
    }

    .feature-icon--green {
      background: oklch(90% 0.08 155);
    }

    .feature-icon--purple {
      background: oklch(88% 0.1 285);
    }

    .feature-icon--coral {
      background: oklch(88% 0.08 45);
    }

    .feature-icon--blue {
      background: oklch(90% 0.06 220);
    }

    .feature-title {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: var(--text-lg);
      font-weight: 700;

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: var(--space-5) var(--space-6);
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: var(--text-base);
      font-weight: 600;
      text-align: left;
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .faq-question:hover {
      background: var(--color-bg-secondary);
    }

    .faq-icon {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: transform var(--transition-base);
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
    }

    .faq-item.open .faq-icon {
      transform: rotate(45deg);
      color: var(--color-accent);
    }

    .faq-answer {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height var(--transition-slow), padding var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .faq-item.open .faq-answer {
      max-height: 400px;
      padding: 0 var(--space-6) var(--space-5);
    }

    .faq-answer p {
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.7;
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
    }

    /* ============================================
       FOOTER
       ============================================ */
    .footer {
      background: var(--color-bg-dark);
      color: oklch(80% 0.02 265);
      padding-block: var(--space-20) var(--space-10);
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-10);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-16);
    }

    .footer-col-title {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--color-white);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
    }

    .footer-links {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-2);
    }

    .footer-link {
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      color: oklch(70% 0.02 265);
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .footer-link:hover {
      color: var(--color-white);
    }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1);
      padding-top: var(--space-8);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-4);

    .footer-logo {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: var(--text-xl);
      color: var(--color-white);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
    }

    .footer-legal {
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      color: oklch(55% 0.02 265);
      max-width: 640px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* ============================================
       RESPONSIVE
       ============================================ */
    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      .hero-ctas {
        flex-direction: row;
      }

      .stats-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      }

        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {

        display: flex;
      }

      .teams-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }

      .footer-grid {

    }

    @media (min-width: 1024px) {

      }

      .footer-bottom {

        justify-content: space-between;
        text-align: left;
      }
    }

      from {

  </style>

      coursesGrid.innerHTML = filtered.map((course, i) => `

    // ============================================
    // FAQ ACCORDION
    // ============================================
    const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');

    faqItems.forEach(item => {
      const question = item.querySelector('.faq-question');
      question.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
        // Close all
        faqItems.forEach(i => i.classList.remove('open'));
        // Open clicked if it was closed
        if (!isOpen) {
          item.classList.add('open');
        }
      });
    });

    // ============================================
    // HEADER SCROLL EFFECT
    // ============================================
    const header = document.querySelector('.header');
    let lastScroll = 0;

    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      const currentScroll = window.pageYOffset;
      if (currentScroll > 100) {
        header.style.boxShadow = 'var(--shadow-md)';
      } else {
        header.style.boxShadow = 'none';
      }
      lastScroll = currentScroll;
    });

    // ============================================
    // INTERSECTION OBSERVER FOR ANIMATIONS
    // ============================================
    const observerOptions = {
      threshold: 0.1,
      rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
    };

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.style.animationPlayState = 'running';
        }
      });
    }, observerOptions);

    document.querySelectorAll('.section-header, .feature-card, .stat-item, .feed-card, .testimonial-card, .faq-item').forEach(el => {
      el.style.opacity = '0';
      el.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
      el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.6s ease-out, transform 0.6s ease-out';
      observer.observe(el);

      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
          entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, observerOptions);

    document.querySelectorAll('.section-header, .feature-card, .stat-item, .feed-card, .testimonial-card, .faq-item').forEach(el => {
      revealObserver.observe(el);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

The CreativeHub landing page has been built and saved to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what was delivered:

- **OKLCH color tokens** throughout — perceptually uniform, accessible, and modern
- **Brand colors**: Black primary, vibrant green (`#55DA9B`) and purple (`#5620C1`) accents, with warm coral for energy
- **Typography**: Plus Jakarta Sans (chunky geometric sans) for headlines + Inter for body text, fluid `clamp()` type scale
- **Spacing**: 8px-based scale with consistent rhythm
- **Three-tier token architecture**: Primitive → Semantic → Component

### Sections Implemented (per `task_input.json`)
| Section | Key Features |
|---|---|
| **Header** | Fixed nav with blur backdrop, logo, browse links, Sign Up CTA |
| **Hero** | Dark background with gradient orbs, badge, bold headline, Google + email CTAs, legal text, horizontal scrolling category pills |
| **Features** | 4-card grid with colored icons (Classes, Pros, Learning Paths, Certificates) |
| **Stats** | Dark band with gradient text — 425k+, 30k+, 9k+, 4.8★ |
| **Courses** | Tabbed grid (15 categories), instant filtering, course cards with gradient thumbnails, duration badge, student count |
| **Creative Feed** | 3-card community feature grid |
| **Teachers** | Horizontal scroll carousel with nav arrows, gradient avatar placeholders, scroll-snap |
| **Testimonials** | 4-card grid with quotes, initials avatars |
| **Teams** | Two-column layout with purple gradient visual card |
| **FAQ** | Accordion — only one open at a time, smooth expand/collapse |
| **Footer** | Multi-column link grid + legal disclaimer |

### Interactions
- **Course category tabs** — instant JS filtering with staggered fade-in animation
- **FAQ accordion** — toggle with auto-close others
- **Teacher carousel** — prev/next buttons scroll by card width
- **Scroll-triggered animations** — IntersectionObserver reveals sections as they enter viewport
- **Header shadow** — appears on scroll

### Responsive
- Mobile-first CSS with breakpoints at 640px, 768px, 1024px
- Horizontal scroll containers hide scrollbars for clean UX
- Fluid typography and spacing scales automatically
